PHMJSlKXm2xTEQ-E7FZB7A.zh: 牙買加11/22報告自10/28颶風侵襲後,累計37例疑及6例死亡病例,其中9例確診。病患多集中於該國西南部蒙特哥貝地區,多為從事農業、清理工作或災後復原之男性。當局表示因電力尚未恢復,無法清理受汙染之水域及環境,致使受感染機率增加。
PHMJSlKXm2xTEQ-E7FZB7A.en: Jamaica reported on 22 November that since the hurricane struck on 28 October, a cumulative 37 suspected cases and 6 deaths have been recorded, of which 9 were confirmed. Cases are concentrated in the south-western part of the country around Montego Bay, mostly among men engaged in agriculture, clean-up work or post-disaster recovery. Authorities said that because power has not yet been restored, contaminated waters and environments cannot be cleaned up, increasing the risk of infection.
